volume_convention: Reported series units, not verified delivery-contract volume. Exclude the latest pre-month bar, then use the preceding 20 recorded bars. Keep zero observations; never fill missing or splice RL and ER histories. The 7-day age and five-row repeat screens are descriptive, not trading or eligibility filters.
funding_convention: Use the supplied monthly RF as a conditional fully collateralized income proxy on capital after entry fees. It is realized holding-period income, not an input to current position decisions. Restart both zero-cash and RF cases flat at January 2000 with prior price history for initialization; liquidate December 2014. No funding spread, cash borrowing, margin utilization or stock-borrow fee is inferred.
adoption: Readiness assessment only. No empirical impact/capacity or margin/borrowing model without the missing contract, AUM, liquidity and funding evidence. Primary strategy settings remain unchanged.
